method_notes: Read-only pcbnew native polygons with 0.20mm candidate copper clearance, broad-phase bounding boxes. No SaveBoard, no fill.

Maximal endpoint chains do not establish removal safety at interior same-net copper contacts; production edits must preserve native connected pads/vias and require strict DRC/parity plus physical return checks.
Octilinear length lower bound ignores obstacles and is not a proved routable replacement.
